subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second bootstrap prompt authority that overrides the agent workspace, or should OpenClaw retain workspace-only bootstrap loading and warn about misplaced files?
rationale: Current docs and runtime ownership make the workspace the bootstrap source, while this PR changes compatibility and a security-sensitive prompt boundary; code review cannot choose that permanent product contract.

options.title: Keep Workspace Canonical
options.body: Retain workspace-only bootstrap loading and land an in-product warning or Doctor recovery for bootstrap files found in `agentDir`.

options.title: Approve AgentDir Overrides
options.body: Adopt explicit agentDir overrides only after fixing effective-agent propagation and adding precedence documentation, upgrade tests, security review, and live proof.

options.title: Pause Loading Changes
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while reviewing the warning-based implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 as the lower-risk interim path.

recommendation.title: Keep Workspace Canonical
recommendation.body: Retain workspace-only bootstrap loading and land an in-product warning or Doctor recovery for bootstrap files found in `agentDir`.

likelyOwner.reason: They have reviewed the current workspace-bootstrap contract and are the strongest available routing candidate for the product boundary decision.
